messages:
Avery C: Okay team — starting a quick thread for the Meridian QBR prep. Need slide owners, top 3 renewal risks, and one-liner exec asks. Can people call their lanes?
Priya S: I can own the onboarding health slide. I'll pull activation + time-to-first-success metrics.
Jonah M: I'll take the renewal risks slide. Quick note: usage dip in Week 6 and two stalled integrations are the big ones.
Lena R: I'll own the enablement / playbook slide. Want to call out new onboarding video and training cadence.
Avery C: Awesome. Can each owner post a 1-sentence summary and a single ask for the execs by EOD Wed?
Priya S: Summary: Activation rate improved 12% after checklist; still seeing 18% drop between trial week 2–3. Ask: Approve $10k for targeted onboarding outreach partner.
Jonah M: Summary: Renewal risk = stalled integrations + low priority tickets backlog. Ask: Escalate integration leads to Product for a fast-path (2-week SLA).
Lena R: Summary: New enablement reduced time-to-first-success by 22% in pilots. Ask: Greenlight weekly office hours for the next quarter.
Avery C: Great. I'll add a one-slide exec readout with top asks and impact metrics. @ops-bot please attach latest health dashboard to this thread.
ops-bot: Attaching: https://dash.redwood.example/customer/meridian/health?view=qbr :paperclip:
Priya S: putting raw numbers in a doc now -> https://docs.redwood.example/meridian-qbr/data
Jonah M: I'll draft the risk mitigation runbook and a 2-week timeline for the canary fix.
Lena R: For the slide layout — can we include a tiny before/after gif for the onboarding flow? I have one ready.
Avery C: Yes, include it. Also add a single metric widget: "Net renewal risk (30d)". If anyone needs design help ping @design-ops.
Priya S: Quick question — who will own the ask during the exec readout? I nominate Avery to voice the onboarding ask and Jonah to voice the integration ask.
Avery C: Happy to take onboarding ask. Jonah you good to present the risk mitigation plan?
Jonah M: Yep, I'll run through the mitigation timeline and show the ticket triage heatmap.
Avery C: Cool. Last bit — please add final slide notes (30–45s talking points) underneath each slide. Target to freeze slides by Thu 10am.
Priya S: Noted. Will post my slide + notes by Wed 6pm.
Jonah M: I'll drop mine by Thu 8am for review.
Lena R: Slide + gif + notes by Wed 9pm.
Avery C: Thank you all. I'll compile and share a review link. If any blockers pop up, call it out here. :thumbsup:
